_note: Death-cum-retirement gratuity under the government pension rules or a similar scheme, and a defence retiring gratuity: deducted in full (D-103; rulebook RET-GRAT-GOVT-001). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.19(1) Table Sl. 3, "Death-cum-retirement gratuity received as referred to in sub-section (2)(g). — Entire amount.", and Sl. 4, "Payment of retiring gratuity received under the Pension Code or Regulations applicable to the members of the defence services. — Entire amount." (p.41); s.19(2)(g) names the Central Civil Services (Pension) Rules, 2021 and similar schemes (p.46). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.10(10)(i) (thc.nic.in p.71), "any death-cum-retirement gratuity received under the revised Pension Rules of the Central Government or, as the case may be, the Central Civil Services (Pension) Rules, 1972, or under any similar scheme … or any payment of retiring gratuity received under the Pension Code or Regulations applicable to the members of the defence services". Neither s.202(2)(a) nor s.115BAC(2)(i) excludes it, so every regime.

introducedBy.instrumentCitation: Finance Act, 2023 (8 of 2023), s.52 — the new regime of s.115BAC(1A), whose s.115BAC(2)(i) does not exclude s.10(10) to (10C), so the entry applies in every regime
